prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the attached approved-adult face reference as the sole identity standard; preserve the adult woman's face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression accurately without celebrity or public-figure substitution. Create a cinematic art-fashion editorial of her standing naturally under an umbrella in visible rain. She wears a deep midnight-blue satin dress with a fluid elegant silhouette, a metallic deep-gold structured handbag, and refined knee-high leather boots in deep metallic gold or warm cognac. Pose her with one hand holding the umbrella handle and the other arm relaxed naturally, with a soft introspective gaze. Give the deep navy umbrella an original swirling painterly star-and-moon sky pattern in gold and cobalt, with a matte printed fabric texture. Set her against softly blurred light stone architecture, visible rain streaks, and subtle wet-ground reflections. Use overcast rainy daylight, moody contrast, 50mm f/2.0 eye-level framing, sharp focus on the subject, slightly motion-blurred rain, satin sheen, rain droplets on umbrella, subtle 35mm film grain, and natural skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, identity blending, AI glow, plastic skin, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, oversharpening, watermark, text
